name: prio_5
oracle_ref: q_prio 2-lane: read/small lane (high) FIFO before large-write lane (low) FIFO
notes: q_prio ignores ioprio. Classifies: read OR nr_sectors<=8 → high-prio lane; large write (>8 sectors) → low-prio lane. Dispatch: high lane FIFO first, then low lane FIFO. Trace: 3 reads (high) + 2 large writes (low). Expected: R0,R8,R16 then W256,W512. NOTE: sync driver with 1-in-flight → order==submission. Need async for lane priority to matter.
